blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA — Jaylen Brown says there’s “no beef” between himself and former Boston teammate Jayson Tatum even as their squabbles have dragged into the season. Now in Philadelphia after an offseason trade, Brown didn’t quite seem ready to call a truce with Tatum. “There’s no beef,” Brown said after the Sixers beat Milwaukee on Saturday night. “There might be a little lamb chops and some gravy. He should stay ready at all times.” Tatum started the postgame back-and-forth on after the Celtics beat the Knicks a night earlier Brown posted a social media response that took issue with Tatum saying in […]...
